cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: New Mexico counts the 36 months ending the last day of your birth month: 120 hours, at least 20 each reporting year, 96 technical and 4 ethics.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 120 hours in the 36 months ending your birth month (16.60.3.15 NMAC).

requirements.label: Technical
requirements.note: At least 96 of the 120 in technical subjects.

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Only 8 nano-learning hours count per three-year cycle.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of ethics in the 36 months (AICPA code, New Mexico code of conduct, Circular 230 and similar).

newLicensee.note: No CPE is required between your issue date and your first expiration.

licenseDateHint: The last day of your birth month (e.g. 03/31/2027).
issueDateHint: If you were licensed during this period, no CPE is due at your first expiration.
limitsNotTracked: At least 24 hours not sponsored by your own firm or employer.
Instruction and authorship combined: max 60 hours; authorship max 50%.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for five years after completion or reporting.
toVerify: Renewal frequency (annual vs triennial in the birth month) — the CPE window is 36 months either way.
